decisions.reason: The candidate already has a complete same-message MODIFY stating that referral-free purchases create six tickets and commission, both allocated by weighted draw.
The landing-page state does not describe the no-referral allocation rule, so the source decision does not necessarily change its current content or layout.
A same-message MODIFY already changes commission recipient selection to a weighted draw among eligible NFT owners; the source does not change the existing commission amount or trigger.
A same-message MODIFY already records six tickets per referral-free purchase and weighted-draw allocation, fully representing the source impact.
The referral-free ticket and commission rule has no effect on landing-page book-cover placement, size, or cropping.
The source decision does not change the current or planned product name.
The source addresses purchases without a referral, while this candidate governs commission allocation when a referral is accepted.
Creating and allocating rewards for a referral-free purchase does not change the source, persistence, or display locations of NFT referral identities.
The source changes reward creation and allocation for referral-free purchases, not what follows an NFT upon transfer.
The source does not alter which referral identifiers are valid or the prohibition on self-referrals; it governs the fallback allocation when no referral is used.
The source does not establish any change to email delivery, contents, or notification behavior.
The no-referral reward rule applies to purchases generally but does not change the Transak provider, payment methods, wallet provisioning, mint destination, or lifecycle state.
